digest.component_or_area: fsck authorship reporting and event signing
propositions: _apply_authorship returns silently when signing_key is configured but author_id is unresolvable and require_authenticated is off (the default), hiding unsigned writes.
fsck authorship tally is aggregated store-wide as a single uncounted advisory line with no per-env breakdown, making per-env signing failures invisible behind other envs' healthy volumes.

AC2: fsck must emit a counted UNSIGNED_ENV issue for any env that has at least one event and either zero signed events or every event authored Unknown/absent, gated to fire only when the store adopted signing and that env wrote at or after the store's earliest signed event.

AC3: _apply_authorship must emit a logger.warning when signing is SKIPPED (lack of resolvable identity or missing signing key), naming the event uuid, ticket, and which input was missing, without failing the write.
